app.title: Vlog Editing UI
ffmpeg.install.title: Install ffmpeg
notifications.title: Notifications
settings.desc.ai.context: Project-specific background injected ahead of every AI prompt
settings.desc.ai.debug_print_prompt: Debug: print the full prompt (including injected context) before every AI call
settings.desc.ai.default_tasks: Global default task bindings inherited by projects that do not override them
settings.desc.ai.provider_ttl_min: Cached AI provider expiry (minutes); rebuilt after the TTL. 0 never expires
settings.desc.ai.providers: AI provider list; each provider has its own API key, endpoint, and limits
settings.desc.ai.providers.{name}.api_ke: API key written inline; lower priority than api_key_env
Environment variable holding the API key (for example GEMINI_API_KEY), not the key itself
settings.desc.ai.providers.{name}.base_u: API base URL; required for OpenAI-compatible endpoints
settings.desc.ai.providers.{name}.capabi: Capability tags. video = video understanding, text = text generation
settings.desc.ai.providers.{name}.max_to: Max tokens per generation; 0 = unlimited (decided by the model or service; recommended for planning tasks)
settings.desc.ai.providers.{name}.models: Model names this provider supports (for example gemini-2.5-flash), used by task-binding dropdowns
settings.desc.ai.providers.{name}.reques: Maximum calls per minute; 0 disables rate limiting
settings.desc.ai.providers.{name}.retry_: Extra retry attempts (default 2, so 3 attempts in total)
settings.desc.ai.providers.{name}.timeou: HTTP timeout for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (seconds), default 120
settings.desc.ai.providers.{name}.type: Provider type: gemini (multimodal video) or openai (text-only compatible API)
settings.desc.ai.tasks: AI task bindings; each step can pick its own provider and model
settings.desc.ai.tasks.{name}.model: Model name, for example gemini-2.5-flash or deepseek-chat
settings.desc.ai.tasks.{name}.provider: Provider name used by this task (defined under providers)
settings.desc.analyze.max_analyze_durati: Hard cap for a whole file (minutes); longer files are skipped. 0 = unlimited. Long clips are mainly governed by window_max_min
settings.desc.analyze.skip_existing: Global skip switch: skip already processed files (affects every step)
settings.desc.analyze.use_gpmf: Optional: inject the .gpmf.json / GPMF probe summary next to the source clip into the AI context (default off; silently skipped without GPS)
settings.desc.analyze.window_max_min: Longest single AI analysis window (minutes); longer input is split into windows and merged
settings.desc.analyze.window_overlap_sec: Overlap between adjacent analysis windows (seconds), used to dedupe boundaries
settings.desc.compress.crf: CRF quality (0-51; lower means better quality and larger files)
settings.desc.compress.max_width: Max width after compression (pixels); height scales proportionally
settings.desc.compress.remove_audio: Remove the audio track (picture only, smaller files)
settings.desc.naming.index_width: Digits used for the index in file names (3 means 001)
settings.desc.paths.ffmpeg: ffmpeg executable path; leave empty to search automatically
settings.desc.paths.ffprobe: ffprobe executable path; leave empty to search automatically
settings.desc.paths.logs_dir: Log directory, rotated hourly as YYYY-MM-DD-HH.log
settings.desc.paths.output_dir: Root directory for every output (compressed video, transcripts, scripts, ...)
settings.desc.paths.project_dir: Project directory holding videos.json and project.yaml
settings.desc.plan.use_transcripts: Inject speech transcripts as planning context
settings.desc.preview.subtitles.enabled: Show subtitles in the plan preview
settings.desc.preview.subtitles.font_fam: Subtitle font family (empty = follow the system)
settings.desc.preview.subtitles.max_line: Maximum lines shown at once in multi-line mode
settings.desc.preview.subtitles.mode: Subtitle display mode: auto | multi | scroll
settings.desc.preview.subtitles.pos_x: Subtitle horizontal position (% of player width, 0-100)
settings.desc.preview.subtitles.pos_y: Subtitle vertical offset (% from the player bottom, 0 = bottom)
settings.desc.proxy.enabled: Enable the proxy (needed to reach Gemini and similar services)
settings.desc.script.target_words: Word limit per voiceover script; short clips shrink automatically with timeline duration
settings.desc.ui.desktop_notifications: Send a system notification while the page is in the background; off by default, the notification center is unaffected
settings.desc.whisper.cache_dir: Whisper model cache directory; leave empty to use the application default
settings.desc.whisper.device: Compute device. auto, cpu, or cuda (GPU)
settings.desc.whisper.engine: ASR engine. local uses faster-whisper; cloud engines (for example aliyun) need an API key in .env
settings.desc.whisper.hf_endpoint: HuggingFace mirror endpoint. hf-mirror.com is recommended in China; leave empty for the official host
settings.desc.whisper.max_segments_per_c: Maximum transcript segments per clip injected into planning
settings.desc.whisper.model_size: Whisper model size. small (fast), medium (balanced), large-v3 (accurate)
settings.dirty_switch_confirm: Settings have unsaved changes. Switch tabs anyway?
settings.fallback_warn: Showing the global config as a fallback. This project has no dedicated project.yaml, so edits affect every project. Consider {link}.
settings.hint.ai_context: Project-specific background (shooting location, itinerary) appended after the default trip_context.md template. Leave empty to use the default template only.
settings.hint.api_key: API key entered inline. Not recommended; prefer api_key_env with a .env file
settings.hint.api_key_env: Environment variable name (for example GEMINI_API_KEY); the actual secret lives in .env at the project root
settings.hint.base_url: API base URL. Leave empty for Gemini; required for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1
settings.hint.whisper_engine: Before using a cloud engine, configure the matching API key under "Global -> Edit .env" (aliyun needs DASHSCOPE_API_KEY), then restart the service.
settings.init.body: This project has no dedicated config file yet.
settings.init.button: Create a config file for this project
settings.init.hint: It is created from the current global config; later edits only affect this project.
settings.init.title: Project config setup
settings.merged_hint: Effective config after merging the global and project layers. Read-only.
settings.task.desc.refine_text: Polish and fix an existing script (follows video analysis by default)
settings.task.desc.video_analyze: Analyze video content (scenes, objects, people, actions, places); needs a multimodal model
settings.task.desc.vlog_plan: Build the clip order and timeline from every asset
settings.task.desc.voiceover: Generate the voiceover script from the analysis result
settings.task_binding.empty_hint: Add a provider in the "Global" tab first.
settings.task_binding.global_hint: These bindings become the default for every project. A project can override individual tasks.
settings.task_binding.project_hint: Tasks without an override keep following the global default binding. Changes only affect this project.
settings.task_binding.rules_hint:
Video analysis (video_analyze) must use a type=Gemini provider (multimodal); other tasks accept any provider.
Ticking "Follow video analysis" reuses the video_analyze binding; untick it to choose separately.
